text:
Priya: Thanks for joining the all-hands thread. Quick follow-ups from today's Q&A — want a concise set of answers we can share with the company and GTM. My ask: can leadership clarify our short pitch vs "cloud AI platforms" and inference runtimes, and list the top 3 competitive risks we should all be aware of?
Ava: Short version for company/sales: "Redwood Inference: predictable, production-grade LLM serving — low latency, transparent economics, and the same runtime whether you're on our hosted API, reserved Dedicated clusters, or your private VPC." :sparkles:
Sam: Tech framing we give to eng teams: emphasize the unified runtime (KV caching, batching, optimized kernels) + deployment parity. Skip deep perf numbers in early chats, focus on predictable SLOs and rollback/rollout features.
Miguel: For roadmap alignment — does this mean we should postpone some experimental model additions and prioritize Dedicated stability/features (autoscaling, burst)?
Ava: Good question. Short answer: prioritize reliability for Dedicated in next quarter (autoscale/observability), but keep a lightweight path for fast model onboarding in Hosted. We need both to keep PLG funnel healthy.
Dana: For marketing — can we get a 1-liner tagline and one slide that contrasts us vs "general cloud AI" and "open-source runtimes"? Need by EOW.
Ava: Tagline suggestion: "High-performance LLM inference, everywhere you need it." One-slide outline: 1) Tradeoff table (latency/cost/control) 2) Unique levers (batching, caching, rollouts) 3) Customer fit examples.
Ethan: Competitor question — how do we talk about managed cloud AI providers that own both models and infra? Do we call them out directly?
Ava: Call out the capability difference: they're model-first, we are serving-first. Focus on outcomes (SLOs, cost predictability, deployment flexibility). Avoid naming competitors in top-level docs — ok for sales playbooks.
Miguel: Noted. One operational ask: can we get a short FAQ for customers about when to choose Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private? I'll draft and share.
Priya: Perfect — Miguel please share draft in #product-marketing when ready. Dana I'll assign the slide and tagline to you + designer.
ops-bot: [deploy] Created ticket INF-4023 for Dedicated stability workstream. Link: https://redwood.internal/t/INF-4023
Priya: Thanks everyone. I'll compile these answers into a single doc and post it to the handbook. :thumbsup:
Ava: Thanks — appreciate the quick followups. Happy to review the doc before it goes to handbook.
Dana: Will do. ETA for slide: Thursday EOD.
Ethan: Will add competitor notes to the sales playbook draft.
Miguel: Drafting FAQ now, should be in #product-marketing within 48h.
Priya: Closing thread — if anyone has more Qs ping me or @Ava. :raised_hands:
